title: Blueberry Anthocyanins from Commercial Products: Structure Identification and Potential for Diabetic Retinopathy Amelioration.
authors: Li, Rui; Ye, Zhan; Yang, Wei; Xu, Yong-Jiang; Tan, Chin-Ping; Liu, Yuanfa
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蓝莓花青素的结构鉴定及其对糖尿病视网膜病变的改善作用，分子对接仅涉及小分子与REDD1蛋白，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合体系完全无关。
abstract: The aim of the present study was to determine the major anthocyanins of blueberry extracts from northeast China and explore their vision health improvement effects. HPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS results suggested that six different anthocyanins were accurately identified, among which the Cy-3-glu (C3G) was the most abundant, ranging from 376.91 +/- 7.91 to 763.70 +/- 4.99 muM. The blueberry extract contained a higher purity of anthocyanins, and the anthocyanosides reached 342.98 mg/kg. The anti-oxidative stress function of C3G on HG-treated ARPE-19 cells were evaluated, and showed that the GSSG level of HG-cells pretreated with 10 muM C3G was significantly decreased, while the Nrf2 and NQO1 gene expression levels were increased. Further molecular docking (MD) results indicated that the C3G displayed favorable binding affinity towards REDD1, and only the B-ring of the C3G molecule displayed binding interactions with the CYS-140 amino acids within the REDD1 protein. It implied that the oxidative stress amelioration effects of C3G on the ARPE-19 cells were related to the REDD1 protein, which was probably via the Nrf2 pathways, although further studies are needed to provide mechanism evidence. The present study provides novel insights into understanding the roles of blueberry anthocyanins in ameliorating oxidative stress-induced BRB damage in the retina.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在鉴定中国东北地区蓝莓提取物中的主要花青素，并探讨其对视力健康的改善作用。HPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS结果表明，准确鉴定出六种不同的花青素，其中Cy-3-glu（C3G）含量最为丰富，范围为376.91 ± 7.91至763.70 ± 4.99 μM。蓝莓提取物中花青素纯度较高，花青素苷含量达到342.98 mg/kg。评估了C3G对高糖处理的ARPE-19细胞的抗氧化应激功能，结果显示，经10 μM C3G预处理的高糖细胞中GSSG水平显著降低，而Nrf2和NQO1基因表达水平升高。进一步的分子对接（molecular docking）结果表明，C3G对REDD1蛋白表现出良好的结合亲和力，且仅C3G分子的B环与REDD1蛋白中的CYS-140氨基酸发生结合相互作用。这表明C3G对ARPE-19细胞的氧化应激改善作用与REDD1蛋白相关，可能通过Nrf2通路实现，尽管仍需进一步研究以提供机制证据。本研究为理解蓝莓花青素在改善氧化应激诱导的视网膜BRD损伤中的作用提供了新的见解。
